title: S4 - Feature-complete MVP
description: Weeks 7-8. Exit: progress dashboard, basic administration, English/Filipino accessibility, interrupted-session recovery and end-to-end checks pass. Eight-week completion is possible only if release validation also passes.
goal: Complete the eight-week MVP and prepare the release environment.
entry_criteria: Confirm owners and realistic capacity before starting.
Required predecessor deliverables are available or scheduled in dependency order.

exit_criteria.description: All sprint issues meet their acceptance criteria and completion evidence requirements.
Demonstrate all three roles, history/charts, bilingual patient flows and recovery after interruptions.

demo: Demonstrate all three roles, history/charts, bilingual patient flows and recovery after interruptions.
risks: Avoid adding a separate web dashboard or new exercise algorithms.
Start distribution verification before the final sprint.

execution_plan.first_week: Work prerequisites first; review integration and measurement risks midweek.
execution_plan.second_week: Integrate, execute acceptance checks, fix defects and demonstrate the sprint outcome.
execution_plan.capacity_policy: Estimates are provisional; reserve approximately 20% of actual team capacity for integration and defects.

issues.title: Build therapist results dashboard and progress charts
issues.description: Show session history and ROM/repetition trends for assigned patients.

functions.name: SupabaseAuthRepository.loadHistory / HistoryJson.path / HistoryViewModel
functions.description: Read one permitted patient history with exercise-version, side and inclusive UTC date filters, 50-record keyset pages, full measurements and account-safe refresh.

functions.name: rehabilitationProgress / ResultsDashboard
functions.description: Render separate comparable ROM/repetition series, historical prescription targets, quality gaps and detailed session states.

acceptance_criteria.description: Filter by patient, exercise, side and date range; show units and measurement quality.
Separate exercise/side series and show prescription changes so incomparable measurements are not silently combined.
Historical targets remain those of the session prescription version.
Empty, partial, interrupted and invalid-measurement sessions are clearly distinguished.

acceptance_criteria.description: Admin privileges are provisioned through a trusted operation; no public self-promotion path exists.
Admin can disable access and manage therapist-patient links with audited changes.
Catalogue edits preserve historical prescription references and supported algorithm versions.
Patient and therapist clients cannot call administrative operations successfully.

issues.title: Harden lifecycle recovery and long exercise sessions
issues.description: Exercise backgrounding, interruptions, rotation, process death and prolonged inference on target phones.

functions.name: recoverInterruptedSession
functions.description: Handle rotation, backgrounding, process death and camera rebind without false counts.
functions.kind: planned capability; implementation names may change

functions.name: sustainLongSession
functions.description: Measure memory, heat and battery behavior and verify quality/performance fallback.
functions.kind: planned capability; implementation names may change

acceptance_criteria.description: A session of the agreed maximum duration does not leak memory or crash on supported devices.
Camera release/rebind and app lifecycle transitions preserve valid counts without processing stale frames.
Thermal throttling and battery use are measured; a documented quality/performance fallback is verified.
Completed results survive process termination and remain eligible for upload.

acceptance_criteria.description: Trace each PDF functional requirement to an implemented flow and validation evidence.
Repeat the complete assigned exercise, offline completion, synchronization and therapist-review scenario.

Publish a week-8 go/no-go report; an eight-week final release requires the S5 validation/deployment criteria too.
